# H6125 experimental support

## Added

- Exact H6125 scene catalogue (240 scenes) and Effect Studio native Single and Multi effects, uploaded over A1 command 02.
- H6125 colour, Kelvin, segment, brightness and music-mode control through the shared H617A paths, with the controller's brightness register and music selector
  re-encoded on the wire.
- Identity-qualified support: only pact 1 controllers on software 1.07.00 or newer and hardware 1.00.03 or newer are enabled.  Other generations expose power
  and identity only.

H6125 remains **Experimental**, included in this stable release with explicit maintainer approval.  Physical owner qualification is still outstanding.
Painted, Advanced, Workshop and authored scene editing remain unavailable.  See `docs/h6125-support.md` for the evidence, limits and owner checklist.

## Shared changes

- Per-model wire translation, A1 command 02 framing and the colour-mode query selector are now profile declarations rather than model-specific branches.

The preceding RC loaded on Home Assistant 2026.10.1 with existing H617A and H6199 entries and returned fresh state; it made no physical writes and was not
tested on H6125 hardware.
